hypotheses.H-differs: the agreement is below 97%: X0 does not start; the disagreeing rows are reported

Arms drawing random tensors (rand_omp, rand_sub, not_rand_sub, the matched pieces, every null; drawn on CUDA in this code) are reported per part, not gated. The median |ld| difference is reported per group.
